## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve.
Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case
Describe the specific use case where this feature would be beneficial.

### Example Query/Interaction
```
User: [Example of how a user would interact with this feature]
System: [Example of expected response]
```

## Impact
- **Who benefits**: [e.g., Support agents, Developers, End users]
- **Frequency**: [How often would this be used?]
- **Priority**: [Low / Medium / High / Critical]

## Implementation Ideas (Optional)
If you have ideas about how this could be implemented, share them here.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or mockups about the feature request here.

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this isn't a duplicate
- [ ] I have considered the impact on existing functionality
- [ ] I am willing to help implement this feature
